answer: Section 20 states that nothing is an offence which is done by a child under seven years of age.
summary_answer: Section 20 states that nothing is an offence committed by a child under seven years of age.
detailed_answer: According to Section 20 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, any act done by a child under the age of seven years is not considered an offence. Additionally, it mentions that acts committed by children above seven and under twelve years of age may be considered based on their maturity of understanding.
final_answer: Section 20 states that nothing is an offence which is done by a child under seven years of age.
